## Source and method

- https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/androidx/health/services/client/data/DataType

Every DataType companion constant on Google's Jetpack reference for androidx.health.services.client.data.DataType (https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/androidx/health/services/client/data/DataType), read on 2026-10-04, joined to the permissions table in Google's Health Services permissions guide (https://developer.android.com/health-and-fitness/health-services/permissions). Name, declared Kotlin type, description and the "Added in" label are copied from the reference; dataTypeClass, valueType and dataPointClass are read from the declared type printed in kotlinType. The permission column is set only where Google's permissions table names the constant, and that table row is published beside it in permissionEvidence; both are null otherwise, never inferred from a similar name.

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | The DataType companion constant | string | 0 of 65 rows |
| `kotlinType` | The declared type exactly as Google prints it | string | 0 of 65 rows |
| `dataTypeClass` | DeltaDataType or AggregateDataType, read from kotlinType | string | 0 of 65 rows |
| `valueType` | The first type argument of kotlinType | string | 0 of 65 rows |
| `dataPointClass` | The data point class kotlinType names | string | 0 of 65 rows |
| `permission` | The permission Google's permissions table lists the constant under; null where the table does not name it | null, string | 39 of 65 rows |
| `permissionEvidence` | The permissions-table row the permission was read from | null, string | 39 of 65 rows |
| `addedIn` | The constant's own "Added in" label; null where its block prints none | null | 65 of 65 rows |
| `deprecated` | yes when the reference marks the constant deprecated | string | 0 of 65 rows |
| `description` | Google's first description paragraph, verbatim | string | 0 of 65 rows |
| `googleDocs` | Google's reference anchor for the constant | string | 0 of 65 rows |
| `page` | This site's row for the data type | string | 0 of 65 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/healthServicesDataTypes.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-health-services-data-types.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-10-04.
- No workflow runs that script: it is run by hand when the sources are re-read.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
